akn: B. Antieau, A. Krause, T. Nikolaus, On the K-theory of Z/p^n, arXiv:2405.04329
conventions: One entry per ring Z/p^n. groups: for every degree 1 <= r <= 100 the p-adic K-group K_r(Z/p^n; Z_p) = sum_j Z/p^{a_j}, as the sorted list of its exponents [a_1, ...] ([] is the zero group); K_0(Z/p^n; Z_p) = Z_p is not listed. akn: "printed" if the group is printed in [AKN, Appendix A] (it agrees with the computed one), "x" if [AKN] mark the degree x (not computed within 48 hours), "beyond" if the degree lies after the last row of the table of [AKN] for this ring; new is true unless akn is "printed". The integral groups are K_r(Z/p^n) = K_r(Z/p^n; Z_p) + Z/(p^i - 1) for r = 2i - 1 and K_r(Z/p^n) = K_r(Z/p^n; Z_p) for even r >= 2 [AKN, Section 1.1, (1), p. 2].
